messages.subject: Masdar 100GW | Market-entry and stakeholder execution for the next growth phase
messages.body:
Dear Masdar Communications Team,

Please place this confidential executive note before Dr. Nikolas Meitanis, Chief Strategy and Corporate Development Officer.

Masdar's move from 65GW toward 100GW by 2030 places the company in a different phase of growth. As capital deployment and geographic diversification accelerate, strategy increasingly depends on the quality of market entry, government alignment, stakeholder execution and institutional trust around each project, not only on investment selection.

Your remit across strategy, corporate development and stakeholder engagement makes this especially relevant. A disciplined country-entry model that links government relations, regulatory pathways, community expectations, local participation and sustainability commitments to investment and project-delivery decisions can help protect schedule, reputation and long-term operating value across a growing international portfolio.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My experience sits at the operating intersection of foreign investment, government, regulators, communities and executive decision-making. I lead or coordinate government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional follow-through. My current portfolio also includes stakeholder work around industrial solar and battery storage and a carbon-accounting evidence program.

I would welcome a senior discussion on where this country-facing execution profile might complement Masdar's strategy and corporate-development platform, particularly across new-market entry, institutional partnerships, stakeholder strategy or regional external-affairs leadership. I have attached a Masdar-specific executive CV focused on those areas.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
